title: What's new in Expense Agent: Improved Approval Process (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Employee use of AI compliance checks
Approval history and audit trail in web app

features.name: AI-driven approval policies
features.description: Admin can enable AI-driven approval policies in setup to flag expenses for review. Policies are configured per expense category, and AI is used selectively only where needed, such as for flight tickets and hotel stays. Approvers see flags before final approval but are not blocked from approving flagged items.
caveats: Uses additional AI tokens when enabled
Requires expense policies configured per category
Itemization of expenses recommended for best results

features.name: Enhanced approval history and audit trail
features.description: Detailed tracking of all changes to expense reports including creation, submission, rejection, resubmission, and posting. History shows timestamps, user names, justifications, and amount changes, available in both web app and Business Central.
caveats: In web app, history exposed to all users regardless of BC user status
In Business Central, requires BC user or accountant with rights to view
Separate tracking for web app actions versus Business Central posting

features.name: Employee manual compliance checks
features.description: Employees can manually run AI compliance checks on their own expense reports before submission to see in advance if expenses are compliant, without automatic execution.
caveats: Manual execution only, not automatic
Requires employee to initiate the check

features.name: Interim approvers
features.description: Support for multiple approval levels where an interim approver can review expense reports for compliance before final approval by manager. Interim approver must approve before the final approver can act.
caveats: Coming in November release (29.1)
Optional feature for complex approval scenarios

features.name: Better approval messaging
features.description: Improved visual messaging during approval process with different icons and colors for approval and rejection actions to make workflow easier.
features.status_evidence_quote: some other approvals again uh coming from uh November 29.1. Better messaging during approval process.
caveats: Coming in November 29.1 release

features.name: Approval limits
features.description: Approvers can be configured with maximum approval amounts (e.g., $2,000) or unlimited approval. Supports two-level hierarchy with one specific amount level and one unlimited level for escalation.
features.status_evidence_quote: from uh November uh minor, you will be able to set up approver with a uh with a maximum approval amount, for example, $2,000
caveats: Coming in November release
Cannot have multiple threshold levels (e.g., cannot set 1000, 2000, 5000)
Supports only two levels: one specific amount and one unlimited

features.name: Ad hoc alternate approvers
features.description: Approvers on leave can delegate all pending expense reports to colleagues who are set up as approvers on an immediate basis.
caveats: Coming in November release
Delegate can only be used if they are set up as approvers
Applies only to already-sent expense reports awaiting approval

features.name: Planned alternate approvers
features.description: Approvers can designate alternate approvers for specific date ranges (e.g., vacation periods). System automatically redirects all expense reports to the alternate approver during that period.
caveats: Coming in November release
Requires advance planning with specific start and end dates

features.name: Travel request approval
features.description: New approval capability for travel requests as separate from expense approval, with dedicated session available.
caveats: Separate session available for details
Status unclear if this is for 2026 Wave 2 or later wave
